{{Infobox auto|Cheese Pizza}}

A '''pizza''' is a baked meal made in batches of 4 from [[dough]], [[tomatoes]] and [[cheese]]. Every pizza grants {{EffectLink|Strength}} for 3 minutes from its tomatoes; the topping decides the healing and any extra effect. There are four: '''cheese pizza''', '''meat pizza''', '''mushroom pizza''' and the secret '''warped pizza'''.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/cheese_pizza.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
Each recipe is 3 dough across the bottom row, 3 tomatoes across the middle and the topping on the top row, and makes 4 pizzas. Obtaining cheese unlocks the cheese, meat and mushroom pizzas.
{{Recipes|Cheese Pizza}}
{{Recipes|Meat Pizza}}
{{Recipes|Mushroom Pizza}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a pizza takes 1.6 seconds.

|-

|-

|-
| {{ItemLink|Warped Pizza}} || Warped fungus, cheese, warped fungus || {{Hp|8}} || Strength (3:00), {{EffectLink|Invisibility}} (5:00)
|}

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
The cheese, meat, mushroom and warped pizzas are all among the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_8.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>

== Warped pizza ==
{{Spoiler}}
The '''warped pizza''' uses raw [[Warped Fungus|warped fungus]] in place of braised mushrooms. Its recipe is secret and never enters the recipe book; making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?''
{{Recipes|Warped Pizza}}
